_comment: RV-P7.3 T4 — hartland_cz LEARNED-overlay conformance variant. NON-GATING (see OverlayConformanceTest's header for the promotion criterion). Rides the SAME hash-pinned authored fixture as the gating declared corpus (aliases.lex.yaml + skills/trend.md) so the two layers are the estate's real ones, and adds an overlay archive built by the same SnapshotWriter the Golem writes with. Classes: learned (a POSITIVE entry serves at LEARNED with the engine's own score), precedence (a term both declared and learned yields both, distinguishable by layer), suppression (a NEGATIVE entry flags its target unbindable and only it), retired (an INVALIDATED entry never serves), fuzzy (a learned alias matches diacritic-stripped input, which is the property a consulted overlay could not have had). Provenance: hand-authored 2026-08-11 against the same hartland BM-arc Czech world, using the H2/H3 vocabulary RV-P7.2's seed sequence established.

_note: the DECLARED layer answers `sklad` for this ref, which is exactly why the assertion is layer-precise: the PROPOSED overlay entry must contribute NOTHING, and `the ref is unreachable` would have been a claim about the wrong layer.
